## old-lux-pools (agent)

this lux cannot move a Run between pools yet. Ask for a size in your own pool.

## old-lux-pools (person)

this lux cannot move a Run between pools yet

## old-lux-stopped (agent)

this lux cannot change a stopped Run's CPUs or memory. Use fewer workers or less data.

## old-lux-stopped (person)

this lux cannot change a stopped Run's CPUs or memory

## unknown-pool (agent)

XL's pool has no host it fits; ask for another size

## unknown-pool (person)

XL's pool has no host it fits

## platform (agent)

XL is in highmem, whose machines are linux/arm64, linux/riscv; this agent's image is linux/amd64 only. Ask for another size, or ask a person to add an arm64 image.

## platform (person)

XL is in highmem, whose machines are linux/arm64, linux/riscv; this agent's image is linux/amd64 only

## platform-an (agent)

XL is in highmem, whose machines are linux/amd64; this agent's image is linux/arm64 only. Ask for another size, or ask a person to add an amd64 image.

## platform-an (person)

XL is in highmem, whose machines are linux/amd64; this agent's image is linux/arm64 only

## platform-unknown (agent)

Large is in its pool, whose machines cannot run this agent's image. Ask for another size, or ask a person to add an image for them.

## platform-unknown (person)

Large is in its pool, whose machines cannot run this agent's image

## nested (agent)

XL is in highmem, which can't run nested containers, and this agent's image needs them. Ask for another size.

## nested (person)

XL is in highmem, which can't run nested containers, and this agent's image needs them

## nested-said (agent)

Large is in its pool, which can't run nested containers, and this agent's image needs them. Ask for another size.

## nested-said (person)

Large is in its pool, which can't run nested containers, and this agent's image needs them

## too-large (agent)

Large (4.5 CPUs · 1.5 GiB) is larger than any machine in its pool. Ask for another size.

## too-large (person)

Large (4.5 CPUs · 1.5 GiB) is larger than any machine in its pool

## invalid-spec (agent)

lux cannot give this agent XL as the size is set up. Ask for another size, or ask a person to check XL in Machines.

## invalid-spec (person)

lux cannot give this agent XL as the size is set up

## not-resumable (agent)

lux was already resuming this Run, so it could not move it to XL. Ask again once you are running.

## not-resumable (person)

lux was already resuming this Run, so it could not move it to XL

## other (agent)

lux would not move this agent to XL. Ask for another size.

## other (person)

lux would not move this agent to XL
